selection_basis: New cases with complete saved outputs from all nine models; varied shapes and bounded download size. Examples are curated, not aggregate benchmark estimates.
part_policy: Stored 3% / 2048-point part scores and Hungarian assignments. Existing display meshes are preserved because showcase assignments are unchanged; historical display alignment used 1024 points, independently of score sampling.

metric_revision.geometry: Normalize per case; average CD score, F@0.01, NC and measured IoU within each valid case, then average case scores within each format.
metric_revision.text_iou: Omit unavailable IoU from the valid case geometry mean; retain generation-invalid cases as failures.
metric_revision.part: Mean of match F1 and F-score mean over all Hungarian pairs; no normalized part mean.
metric_revision.part_sampling_rng: MT19937 legacy uniform sequence with explicit Generator
metric_revision.iou: Omit unavailable IoU from the valid case mean, never worst-fill it. Standalone IoU averages measured values from valid outputs only, retaining measured zeros.
